analysis.headline: Summary says the customer called the company, but the agent made an outbound call (T01); it also omits the consent given to record the vulnerability (T09-T11).

claims.explanation: Name, DOB and address/postcode were verified and the agent confirmed security was complete.

evidence.quote: Neil Stone, tenth of August nineteen eighty-seven. 29 Hazel Close, Leicester, LE3 8GH.

claims.text: The customer called the company, and arrears were discussed.
claims.explanation: The agent opened the call asking for the customer, so it was outbound (the company called the customer). Arrears were discussed (T07).

evidence.quote: I'm calling from vehicle finance collections.
there's a missed instalment and arrears showing

claims.text: Absence from work due to depression reduced monthly income by £500 when full pay ended;
claims.explanation: The customer is off sick with depression, full pay stopped and income is roughly £500 lower a month. The figure is approximate ('roughly'), which the summary does not reflect, but this is minor.

evidence.quote: It's roughly five hundred pounds less a month.

claims.explanation: The agent asked permission to record the depression and reduced pay and the customer agreed. The summary should say 'Consent gained to record vulnerability.'
The customer agreed to complete I&E and a call was arranged.

evidence.quote: We can call on the twenty-third of October after two to complete it.

claims.text: the customer was referred to StepChange and customer signposted to the company website,
claims.explanation: The agent mentioned StepChange for free debt advice and pointed to the website support page.

evidence.quote: StepChange can provide free debt advice
support page on our company website

claims.text: and the agent checked understanding of the contact hold and possible credit file impact.
claims.explanation: The agent explained the hold and credit file impact and the customer said 'I understand', but the agent did not explicitly ask whether the customer understood. The reviewer should check this.

evidence.quote: guarantee that there won't be a credit file impact

claims.text: A seven-day hold on collection contact was applied while retaining the agreed assessment call;
claims.explanation: The agent applied a seven-day hold and kept the assessment call.

evidence.quote: I've applied a seven-day hold on collection contact while you seek advice.

claims.text: the next steps are to prepare financial figures with the support worker, seek advice and take the company’s call on 23 October at 2 pm;
claims.explanation: 23 October (Friday) is supported, but the transcript says 'after two', not 'at 2 pm'. The reviewer should check this time.
The customer confirmed that no payment was agreed.

omissions.title: Consent to record vulnerability not stated
omissions.detail: The agent asked permission to note the depression and reduced pay and the customer agreed (T09-T11). The rules require the explicit phrase.
